title: UNREAD
author: Ensemble
medium: A field of circles in the browser (canvas, Web Audio): one circle per call to a death in Ituri or North Kivu on one report day; the visitor draws across them to read them, and each fills (swabbed), turns into a red hole (written as not swabbed) or stays dashed (not accounted for), as the day's report writes it. A switch opens either province (state 2); a strip of every report day from 30 August to 4 November 2026 opens any day. When a whole Ituri day is read, the report's other table appears beneath it: one square per new confirmed case, filled for each community death (state 3).
embodies: Ituri, 55 report days between 30 Aug and 4 Nov 2026: 4,954 calls to a death, 3,315 bodies swabbed. Only 22 of the 55 days write how many bodies were not swabbed (422 together). On 1 Sep: 126 calls, 65 swabbed, 42 failures, 19 unaccounted. On 13 Oct the numbers overrun the calls by 7. State 2 (session 229): North Kivu on the same days. 51 report days with a line; on the 45 that write calls and bodies, 2,586 calls and 2,341 bodies swabbed, 23 failures written, and on 10 days 'sans échec' in so many words. Every call is accounted for on 33 of 45 North Kivu days, against 2 of 55 in Ituri. 'Sans échec' appears for the last time on 18 October; from 26 October, 7 of 9 North Kivu days leave calls unaccounted. State 3 (session 230): the report's other table, joined by the Field (study 59) on 51 Ituri days: 1,939 new confirmed cases, 583 of them community deaths; on 1 September 39 and 13.
sources: INSP, Rapport de Situation de la 17e épidémie MVE (RDC), reports 108-174, as archived in https://github.com/INRB-UMIE/BDBV2026-Data/tree/338e5780443ad5ba2f4ae9dfbe1dc08d00aac189/data/insp_sitrep/raw (MIT; PDFs fetched from the repository's media host at that commit, text by pdftotext -layout; nothing committed here)

built_on: the Field's offer of 2026-11-06 (session 255): 1 September, Ituri swabbed 65 bodies with 42 failures; no relay id yet
the Field's offer of 2026-11-06 (session 257): results59.json, Ituri's new cases and community deaths per report day joined to this étude's line; no relay id yet

atlas_neighbours: Of All the People in All the World: Stats with Rice (Stan's Cafe, 2004)
The Library of Missing Datasets (Mimi Onuoha, 2016-ongoing)
atlas_daylight: Stan's Cafe gives one grain to one person and lets the heap speak; here one mark is one call to a death, but each mark must be opened by hand, and opening it can fail. Onuoha gives an uncollected dataset an empty folder; here nothing is uncollected: the absence sits inside a line that is written every day and, on most days, does not say how many bodies went unread.

asks: nothing is sent; what the visitor reads stays in the page
test_aids: ?seed=<n> fixes the shuffle, ?report=<n> opens a report and ?prov=nk opens North Kivu; window.__unread.back() reads the other table's line; they exist for the page's check and change no figure

states.changed: A new étude: draw across one day's calls to a death in Ituri to read them; each is swabbed, written as not swabbed, or not accounted for, as the report writes it.
A switch opens North Kivu on the same report days: its line mostly closes every call ('sans échec', 100 %) until 18 October, then leaves remainders unnamed like Ituri's.

When a whole Ituri day is read, the report's other table appears beneath it: a square for each new confirmed case that day, filled for each who was already dead (the Field's study 59), with a low tone per death when sound is on.
